per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP sequence identities for KW2, KW4, and KW5 agree with primary XML peptide synthesis and merged all_sequences.csv. Exact Table 1 MIC/toxicity rows are source-verified. MBIC90 and selected salt/pH or resistant-strain qualifier rows remain source_conflict, preserved as caution findings instead of forced to source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity evidence now uses peptide names as entities, separates MIC from cytotoxicity/hemolysis, adds Supplementary Table S1, and records KW4 biofilm inhibition only as the source-supported >80% threshold at 25 µM.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to KW4 non-membranolytic action with direct RNA binding/cytosolic localization evidence and membrane-binding context; DNA binding remains inferred/proposed, not promoted to direct assay evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_layer: The prior open rework ticket was addressed by source review of the requested XML, supplement, and database paths; no blocking or major owner-layer rework remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Five linked DBAASP assay/experiment claims remain source_conflict because local primary text/tables do not state exact MBIC90 or resistant-strain salt/pH qualifiers; primary-supported MIC, toxicity, biofilm threshold, and sequence rows were retained.

Figure 2 and Figure 5 images were opened for source review, but exact chart-derived values were not fabricated into table-grade database values when source text gave only qualitative or threshold statements.
The only supplementary asset is a PDF; local text extraction yielded Table S1 and Figures S1-S2, with no spreadsheet tables to recover.
